author: agent:claude-code
message: parda's graft (numerics for parda-2d in place of glam), accepted by the user: a new area planned in three milestones, in a no_std crate of autodyne's workspace, each piece offered when it matches or beats glam and plain loops. (proposal 01a10a63-8752-7674-bc9d-8882969270c3, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

name: lanes M1
intent: What parda-2d's M1 needs: the small vector and matrix types and the damped-spring kernel, in a no_std build, at least as fast as glam.

name: lanes M2
intent: The rest of the batched kernels: world-matrix composition, bulk homography transforms, tweens and easing.

name: lanes M3
intent: Portable SIMD f32 lanes with runtime dispatch, for parda-cpu's tiled software rasterizer.

name: Geometry and lanes
intent: Small fixed-size geometry, batched kernels over structure-of-arrays data, and portable SIMD lanes, in a no_std + alloc crate of autodyne's workspace that autodyne re-exports and other projects (parda-2d first) depend on alone. Built to replace glam and hand-written loops: each piece is adopted when it matches or beats them in benchmarks.

text: Its crate is no_std + alloc and builds for wasm32: none of faer, rustfft, cranelift or cubecl, and nothing from the rest of autodyne (it sits below Core).
Every type and kernel is benchmarked against glam (single values) or a plain loop (batched kernels), results agreeing first; a piece is offered for adoption only when it's equal or faster.

name: small types
intent: Vec2, Vec3, Vec4, Mat3 and Mat4: column-major, #[repr(C)], bytemuck Pod, with the usual operations (products, inverse, transpose, from translation / rotation / scale) at least as fast as glam for single values.

name: springs
intent: Lane-wise closed-form damped-spring updates over structure-of-arrays (position, velocity, target, stiffness, damping), under-, critically and over-damped, exact for any time step.

name: lean build
intent: The crate without std (alloc only), compiled for wasm32 in CI, usable with default-features = false.

name: batched kernels
intent: World matrices for many nodes at once (parent * local by index arrays), points transformed by a homography in bulk, tweens with easing curves: one loop over every lane, faster than per-element calls.

name: simd lanes
intent: f32x4, f32x8 and f32x16 on stable Rust with runtime dispatch (SSE2 / AVX2 / AVX-512 on x86-64, NEON on aarch64) and wasm simd128, with the rasterizer's operations (signed distances, coverage, premultiplied blending) 8 or 16 pixels at a time.

title: Publish the lanes crate to crates.io
body: parda wants it from crates.io under the library combo. Publishing is the user's call: name, version, and whether the draft license texts are reviewed first.
